name: lumo-browser
description: Lumo Browser - An AI-native, production-ready browser built with Chromium and Electron
author: Sai

scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron . --no-sandbox
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: npx esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=dist/main/main.js --external:electron --external:adblock-rs --external:lumo-adblocker-rs && npx esbuild src/main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=dist/main/preload.js --external:electron && npx esbuild src/main/webview-preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=dist/main/webview-preload.js --external:electron
scripts.lint: eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx && cd backend && npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx --fix && cd backend && npm run lint -- --fix
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,json,css}" && cd backend && npm run format
scripts.type-check: tsc --noEmit && cd backend && npm run build
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist build out node_modules && cd backend && rm -rf dist node_modules
